scope: Private cosmetic-vendor and wardrobe replies identify the snapshot's owning character. The vendor ignores missing/wrong owners, invalid balances, ambiguous acknowledgements, closed screens and disposed instances.
Opening the vendor clears the old catalogue, collection, selection, balance and preview while loading. Changing characters also discards the former character's pending unlock context.

Fresh catalogues invalidate retired buttons and price confirmations. Purchases use the explicitly reviewed offer, price and catalogue generation; pending retries keep the same unique unlock and price.

Disposal is idempotent: retained buttons or delayed results cannot send purchases, reopen the dialog or recreate its renderer. Preview equipment remains presentation-only and actual combat gear is unchanged.
